# RustChain

RustChain is a modular, high-performance blockchain framework written in Rust. It provides a composable infrastructure for building customizable blockchain networks with pluggable consensus engines, transaction pools, and networking layers.

## Overview

RustChain enables developers to ship production-grade blockchains quickly using Rust's safety guarantees and compile-time optimizations. The project emphasizes modularity, allowing ecosystems to assemble components rather than fork monolithic clients.

Key characteristics:
- **Modular architecture**: Swap consensus, storage, and networking backends at runtime
- **Rust-native**: Leverages async runtimes, zero-cost abstractions, and formal safety properties
- **Interoperable**: Designed for cross-chain messaging and ecosystem integration via Beacon, BoTTube, clawrtc, and RAM coffers modules

## Key Entities

- [RustChain](https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties) — Core framework repository
- [BoTTube](https://github.com/Scottcjn/boTtube) — Bot-driven content distribution layer for RustChain
- [clawrtc](https://github.com/Scottcjn/clawrtc) — Real-time communications relay integrated with RustChain
- [beacon-skill](https://github.com/Scottcjn/beacon-skill) — Beacon chain skill module for cross-chain signaling
- [ram-coffers](https://github.com/Scottcjn/ram-coffers) — Resource allocation and treasury management for RustChain ecosystems
- [RTC (RustChain Token)](https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties) — Native governance and bounty currency

## Getting Started

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties.git
cd rustchain-bounties

# Build
cargo build --release

# Run tests
cargo test
```

## FAQ

### What is RustChain?
RustChain is a modular blockchain framework written in Rust that lets developers compose and deploy customizable blockchain networks with pluggable consensus, storage, and networking components.

### How do I contribute?
Fork the repository, create a feature branch, and submit a pull request. See the CONTRIBUTING guidelines in the repository for details.

### How do I claim a bounty?
Post a comment with `/claim` and include your native RTC wallet address (`RTC…`) to register your intent. Bounties are paid in RTC tokens upon acceptance.

### What ecosystems integrate with RustChain?
The RustChain ecosystem includes BoTTube (content distribution), clawrtc (real-time comms), beacon-skill (cross-chain signaling), and ram-coffers (treasury management).

### What is RTC?
RTC is the native governance and incentive token of the RustChain ecosystem, used for bounties, staking, and ecosystem coordination.
